title: Borrow the labels, read the probabilities (25 Nov 2026)
summary: A 150M encoder trained only on a rented decision model's labels lands within a point of its teacher, mistakes included; Comet's 1.7B LoRA judge beats off-the-shelf judges on pattern questions but not on correctness; Barclays reads per-field confidence from token probabilities and turns the uncertain fields into training data; Sheffield shows logit scoring beats asked-for confidence in zero-shot classifiers; and Intel counts how many decisions compression flips.
